items.title:
io.github.yuku123:z-kb 1.0.2 发布, z-kb — 自研产品级知识库系统，对标 LightRAG + BookStack/Mindoc + RAGFlow + Anything-LLM 的融合形态。
        以 z-vector(向量库) + z-graph(图数据库) + z-util(工具集) 为基础设施，
        提供 Markdown 文档管理、混合检索（向量+全文+图谱）、RAG 问答、工作台会话、版本快照、双向链接、知识图谱可视化等能力。
        目标：达到可直接售卖的成熟度。

A self-hosted session is metered at the published self-hosted rate (https://docs.bithuman.ai/guides/pricing); a credential the service rejects keeps rendering for a five-minute grace, then the session refuses, while a service that cannot be reached never stops a render. Bundles the engine's native library plus libonnxruntime.so and libc++_shared.so for arm64-v8a.
